app.name: SLA Watch
app.description: Correlate provider SLAs with Dynatrace evidence and service ownership

scopes.name: storage:entities:read
scopes.comment: Read services and managed entities for the SLA watch

scopes.name: environment-api:entities:write
scopes.comment: Add or remove an explicitly confirmed provider tag on selected service entities

scopes.name: storage:events:read
scopes.comment: Read problem events that can affect SLA posture

scopes.name: storage:metrics:read
scopes.comment: Read service health signals for SLA evaluation

scopes.name: storage:logs:read
scopes.comment: Check whether correlated log telemetry exists

scopes.name: storage:spans:read
scopes.comment: Check whether distributed tracing telemetry exists

scopes.name: state:user-app-states:read
scopes.comment: Restore personal theme and onboarding preferences

scopes.name: state:user-app-states:write
scopes.comment: Save personal theme and onboarding preferences

scopes.name: state:app-states:read
scopes.comment: Read shared SLA Watch provider configuration

scopes.name: state:app-states:write
scopes.comment: Save shared SLA Watch provider configuration
